criteria.description: Understands threats, vulnerabilities, defense in depth and incident basics; can explain core concepts and participate in guided work.
Can complete simple tasks involving threats, vulnerabilities, defense in depth and incident basics, using established examples and checking results.
Can independently produce and maintain basic cybersecurity safeguards, applying relevant quality checks and documenting decisions.
Can resolve complex issues in basic cybersecurity safeguards, evaluate trade-offs, review others' work and guide colleagues.
Can define organization-wide standards and strategy for basic cybersecurity safeguards, justify architecture or operating approaches and mentor experienced practitioners.
